title: Integral compact-support scalar mate in lifted coefficients
statement: Let l be prime, E and F finite extensions of Q_l and i:E→F a Q_l-algebra map. On the completed rings of the lifted datum [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete], use the coefficient inverse-image identifications of [lem-cbc-integral-compact-support-uniform-restriction]. Let a be any Change of [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data] whose coefficient maps are precisely pbcScalarCoefficientMap of [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. For Noetherian finite-dimensional X,Y with stalkwise invertible l, a quasi-compact f:X→Y and compactification c, the specified integral mate comparison(a,c) is an isomorphism on every bounded constructible complete lattice on X. The assertion concerns the given integral map only; it asserts neither naturality on rational fractions nor construction of a rational functor. The named coefficient system is the existing construction of [def-pur-rational-purity-coefficient-models].

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-completed-integral-finite-free] to integralCompletedScalarMap, using its finite-projection normalization. The coefficientScalar_square of [def-pur-completed-coefficient-presentation-transport] identifies that map with pbcScalarCoefficientMap under purCoefficientIso. Transport the resulting finite-product basis through the inverse ring-sheaf isomorphisms using freeTransport. This proves the private liftedScalar_finiteFree helper, with no completeness or geometric hypotheses.

Use ha Y to view that basis as the basis for the given Change a. Apply [lem-pur-finite-free-proper-scalar-comparison] to c.g and the exact open extension of K.obj. The open scalar component is invertible by openComparison_isIso, and comparison_factorization of [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison] is the proper scalar component followed by the proper image of the open scalar component. Functors preserve isomorphisms and so does composition; this proves the stated component invertible.

Both supply the source arguments, not a direct specialization to these lifted rings. No blueprint duplicate for the lifted preservation statement.

lean.statement:
theorem pbcPurityCompactScalar_integral_isIso (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E F : Type u) [Field E] [Field F] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [Algebra (Padic l) F]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) F]
    (i : E →ₐ[Padic l] F)
    (a : PurCompactSupport.Change
      (pbcPurityCoefficients l E)
      (pbcPurityCoefficients l F))
    (ha : ∀ W, a.map W = pbcScalarCoefficientMap l E F i W)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] (c : Compactification f)
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [dX : Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim X ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞))]
    [dY : Fact (∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim Y ≤ (n : WithBot ℕ∞))]
    [iX : Fact (∀ x : X, IsUnit (l : X.presheaf.stalk x))]
    [iY : Fact (∀ y : Y, IsUnit (l : Y.presheaf.stalk y))]
    (K : PbcBoundedConstructibleComplete X (pbcIntegralDatum l E)) :
    IsIso ((PurCompactSupport.comparison a c).app K.obj)
